description: Source code for PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) scheduling helpers, including functions for scrambling, resource matching, and handling PUCCH PDUs in a 5G NR context.

classes.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler
classes.description: Handler class for managing existing PUCCH PDUs, including creation, updating, and removal based on scheduling logic.

methods.name: get_n_id0_scrambling
methods.description: Calculates the scrambling ID 0 based on UE configuration and cell PCI, following 3GPP TS 38.211 specifications.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::get_next_pdu
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the next PUCCH PDU for scheduling, assigning a unique ID.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::remove_unused_pdus
methods.description: Removes unused PDUs associated with a specific RNTI from the list.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_sr_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the bits for a scheduling request (SR) PDU.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_csi_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the bits for a Channel State Information (CSI) PDU.

methods.name: pucch_existing_pdus_handler::update_harq_pdu_bits
methods.description: Updates the bits and resources for HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) PDUs, including resource reallocation based on new data.
